name: human-losing-big
notes: H2: vanilla never marks a faction LosingBig by strength (Losing is tested first). With the fix, a faction below half its strongest rival's strength is LosingBig. Vanilla: only Losing appears.
asserts: any(faction(r, f).get('self') == 'LosingBig' for r in metrics for f in ['ResistCouncil','DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil'])
info: [(r['t'], {f: faction(r, f).get('self') for f in ['ResistCouncil','DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}) for r in metrics]
